apl_note: Real, same finding as Arcane Mage's own Stage 6.9: presets.ts's own canonical P1/P2/P3 preset builds all select rotationType TypeSimple + APL_SIMPLE (RetributionPaladin.Rotation's useExorcism/consecrationRank/delayMajorCDs/prepullSotC/aura fields) - but grepping the vendored Go engine (sim/paladin/*.go, sim/paladin/retribution/*.go) for these exact field names (case-sensitive: UseExorcism/DelayMajorCDs/PrepullSotC) finds ONLY the proto-generated file, confirming the same dead-TypeSimple-path pattern already found for Mage, not wired up in this engine version. Used default.apl.json (real TypeAPL, confirmed non-dead) instead - no separate player.retributionPaladin.rotation block needed since a TypeAPL rotation doesn't consume those spec-Rotation fields at all (same reasoning as Arcane Mage).
